dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast dark perimeters transitioning to lighter centers. Notable 3-5 rings in the mid-lateral region show sharp geometric boundaries and consistent internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical, solid low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the anterior-dorsal transition and interspersed among lateral annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent central macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, while two larger posterior rings align with a lower-lateral dark blob to form a secondary linear-obtuse configuration.
